articles.summary: TWO Board Continues to Delay, Extending Poor Governance and Oversight UWMC Is Open to Changes or Enhancements to Its Proposal Through Open Engagement with TWO UWM Holdings Corporation (“UWMC” or the “Company”) (NYSE: UWMC) , today issued an open letter to the stockholders of Two Harbors Investment Corp. (“Two Harbors” or “TWO”) (NYSE: TWO) regarding the TWO Board’s continued efforts to salvage TWO’s inferior proposed merger with CrossCountry Mortgage, LLC ("CrossCountry" or "CCM"), despite having twice held meetings that failed to secure stockholder approval for the proposed CCM transaction.
